messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: SLA_BREACH blinkpay-prod - 3m error-rate > 5% (customers impacted). Pager /page @oncall-engineer
Maria R: saw this, paging in progress. I'm grabbing the tenant logs and will triage.
PagerDuty Bot: Paging Maria R (on-call). Incident created: INC-2026-0421-847.
Ashish K: i'm on standby, can help with throttles. Any immediate mitigation?
Maria R: initial look: 95th latency is fine but POST /generate is returning 5xxs from model pool, looks correlated to backend reject rate. Probably overloaded KV cache after a rollout.
Sam T: which model pool? I see elevated queue depth on pool-gpu-11 (eu-west).
Elena M: @Sam can you check if pool-gpu-11 had a rolling deploy 10m ago? Deploy bot traces show canary finished 9m ago.
Sam T: checking... yes thats the one. Canary introduced a tiny change to KV eviction logic.
Maria R: ok immediate mitigation: switch blinkpay tenant to fallback model variant (smaller) and enable request-rate cap for the tenant to limit retries. Ashish can you run the route override?
Ashish K: on it. Patch: 
```bash
redwood route update --tenant blinkpay --model rdlm-small-v2 --override-rate 30rps
```
Ashish K: applied. routing change pushed, cache warmed for fallback.
Incident Bot: NOTE: change made by Ashish K (routing override).
Maria R: monitoring now. Error-rate down to ~1.2% after 45s. Latency stable.
L2 Support: customer portal shows a short spike in failed requests around the alert window, support ticket created (SUP-9872).
Sam T: also rolled back the small eviction change on pool-gpu-11 to prevent recurrence. Patch id: gc-evict-2026-0421.
Elena M: good. For post-incident: we should tune tenant-specific checks. Current SLA alert evaluates global error rate for symptomatic endpoints; noisy tenants with large bursty workloads create false positives.
Maria R: agreed. Proposal: change alert to be tenant-aware and require sustained window + operator count. New alert logic suggestion: only alert if (tenant_error_rate > 5% AND tenant_rps > 5) for 3 out of 5 minutes, and designate severity only if customer SLA risk flag is set.
Ashish K: thumbs up. Also add a secondary signal: model_pool_reject_rate > 2% to avoid surfacing client-side spikes.
OpsAutomation Bot: Draft PR created: github.com/redwood/alerts/pulls/412 - adds tenant_label filtering + min_rps.
Maria R: tagging this as immediate postmortem action - add dashboard and remove noisy synthetic check.
Elena M: dashboard reqs: per-tenant time series for 2xx/4xx/5xx, model_pool_reject_rate, rps, queue_depth. Add an annotation for routing overrides and deploys.
Sam T: rough datadog query for tenant error rate: 
```text
avg(last_1m):100 * (sum:trace.requests{tenant:blinkpay,status:5xx}.as_count() / sum:trace.requests{tenant:blinkpay}.as_count())
```
Maria R: nice. For alert rule JSON snippet: 
```json
{
  "name": "tenant_sla_breach",
  "expr": "tenant_error_rate > 0.05 AND tenant_rps > 5",
  "for": "3m",
  "labels": {"severity": "page"},
  "annotations": {"runbook": "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tenant-sla"}
}
```
Elena M: after-hours followup: we should audit all tenant alerts and add a noisy-tenant exemption list (for high-churn demo tenants). Add a cron job to surface tenants that trigger the alert more than X times/week.
Ashish K: I'll own the exemption list pipeline. Will prototype a daily report that writes to /ops/alerts/noisy-tenants.csv.
Maria R: Sam, can you add the routing-change and deploy annotations to the dashboard? Also add a quick link to the fallback toggle so oncall can flip without a runbook search.
Sam T: added the dashboard panel and link. Patch merged: dashboards/#278.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-2026-0421-847 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
Maria R: moving to monitoring. I will open the postmortem and run a blameless RCA; timeline/notes in the doc. Followups: (1) alert rule changes PR review (2) noisy-tenant report (3) dashboard annotations (4) add automated fallback runbook.
L2 Support: support ticket SUP-9872 updated with mitigation notes and ETA for customer-facing status update. :white_check_mark:
Elena M: can we add a short-term threshold change too? i.e. bump global alert threshold to 7% while we complete changes to avoid another noisy page during fix window. We should track the change in the incident log and revert in 24h.
Maria R: agree. I'll make the temporary threshold change with an expiry tag.
Maria R: applied temporary threshold bump to 7% with auto-revert in 24h. OpsAutomation Bot: change recorded in audits/alerts/changes.log.
Ashish K: will follow up on exemption list PR by EOD.
Sam T: will schedule a model pool canary rollback safety check for future rollouts.
Maria R: thanks all — marking thread for postmortem writeup. If you have notes or screenshots drop them here. :memo:
Incident Bot: INC-2026-0421-847 -> closed (mitigated) at 1798004834
